decision: M03d Gen 5 species experience yields, approved 2026-09-12

audit.unaffected_at_gen_5: 514 gated on >= GEN_4 or >= GEN_5 stay on their current branch.
audit.affected_at_gen_5: 300 gated on >= GEN_6, GEN_7, GEN_8 or GEN_9 fall back to the B2W2 value.
audit.magnitude: Median and mean Gen 5 / present-day ratio both 0.90, so affected species are worth about 10% less experience. Examples: Clefable 242->213, Nidoking 253->223, Alakazam 250->221, Gengar 250->225, Krookodile 260->229.
audit.exceptions_needed: None. This is the first M03 decision requiring no pin.

exception_check.megas: All 35 Mega entries with a selector fall back to a genuine Gen 6 or Gen 7 figure, not a pre-Mega placeholder. Mega Venusaur 313->281, Mega Alakazam 300->266 (its Gen 6 value; the Gen 7 rise came with the Sp. Def change that M03a pinned for base stats only). Chimecho Mega and Lucario Mega Z fall below 200 but are compiled out by P_GEN_9_MEGA_EVOLUTIONS.
exception_check.zero_check: No species' Gen 5 branch resolves to an expYield of 0.

package_note: This completes the Gen 5 experience package started in M02. The rules (participant division, level scaling, trainer bonus, no catch experience, held-item Exp. Share) and the yields those rules multiply now both come from Black 2 / White 2.
limits: One test assertion was written as 270 for Mega Alakazam and corrected to 266 after reading the three-branch selector; no production data was changed.
Static resolution plus runtime assertions over sampled species; not an exhaustive per-species audit.
No pacing or playtest validation. The level curve for trainers and wild encounters is unwritten and affects progression far more than this setting does.
P_UPDATED_EVS, P_UPDATED_FRIENDSHIP and P_UPDATED_EGG_GROUPS remain inherited and unapproved.
The existing linker RWX warning is unchanged; this is not a warning-free or release certification.
